cohort: Women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who were treated with either glyburide or insulin detemir at a university-affiliated tertiary hospital.
finding: While good glycemic control rates were comparable between groups, hypoglycemic episodes occurred only in the glyburide group (19.4% vs 0%, p = 0.01), and maternal weight gain during pregnancy was significantly higher in the glyburide group (8.8 kg vs 2.1 kg, p < 0.001).
